text:
Alex: heads-up — found weird embedding phase shift when prefill crosses 65536 tokens on the new int8-quant model :eyes:. minimal repro below.

Sam: can you paste repro steps?

Alex: steps:
```
# run test harness
python tests/longctx_repro.py --model openredwood-7b-int8 --prefill 66000 --prompt-file samples/long_prefill.txt --save-kv kv_dump.npy
```
Got divergence between baseline fp16 and int8 after ~65536th token.

Maria: logs?

Alex: pasted key snippet: ```
[run] seq=65534 tok_loss=1.02
[run] seq=65535 tok_loss=1.03
[run] seq=65536 tok_loss=3.47  <-- sudden spike
[run] kv_index=0xFFEE -> mapped offset -1
```

Ciara: hmm looks like pointer wrap to negative offset; maybe our wrap logic uses a 16-bit index somewhere. Did quant build change memcpy/layout?

Sam: I can repro locally with the same script, starting now. tagging @Rachel for kernel selection review.

Rachel: on it. Did you try forcing eager-kv-copy=false? sometimes memalign differences hide bugs.

Alex: tried both true/false, same spike. But when I prepend a 1-token warmup after prefill, spike disappears.

Maria: that suggests a boundary condition at prefill boundary — maybe our rotary sin/cos table recompute is misaligned at exactly 2^16 tokens. I'll run a patch that does explicit modulo check.

deploy-bot: load test started for commit r-5402 on infra/longctx (http://ci.redwood/tests/5402) :rocket:

Sam: thanks. If Rachel repros, let's capture kv_dump.npy and attach to bug.

Alex: attaching link to dump: http://files.redwood/kv_dumps/1954306789-kv.npy

Ciara: opening issue #INF-423 with logs and initial hypothesis.

Sam: update - I can reproduce on cpu-quant build only; gpu fp16 seems fine.

Rachel: looking into kernel selection fallback that was merged in r-5398.

Alex: thanks team — keeping this thread for quick notes. I'll post a minimal testcase later. :thumbsup:
